key.name: temperature
key.description: Position of the temperature crossfade between the two frontlights. The lower half ramps the amber channel from off to the full luminance over an untouched white channel; the upper half dims the white channel, reaching pure amber (white off) at 1. -1 means unset: the extension migrates the legacy warmth ratio on first start.

key.name: luminance
key.description: The overall frontlight level both channels are mixed from, as set by GNOME's own brightness controls. Persisted by the extension because the white channel's sysfs value stops being the luminance once the temperature scales it down. -1 means unset: the extension adopts the white channel's current level on first start.

key.name: warmth
key.description: The pre-temperature model: amber driven to this share of the white channel. Read once to seed the temperature key; no longer written.
